Dear Mr. Fenlor,

Seli really enjoys stories and loves being read to, but she tends to lose confidence when she has to read aloud. I think a short weekly practice session in a relaxed setting could help her feel more comfortable and build her confidence.

Thank you very much for your time and help.

Kind regards,
